outgoing.name: Algorithm
outgoing.excerpt: In theoretical chemistry, chemists, physicists and mathematicians develop algorithms and computer programs to predict atomic and molecular properties and reaction paths for chemical reactions.

outgoing.name: Computer science
outgoing.excerpt: The term computational chemistry is also sometimes used to cover any of the areas of science that overlap between computer science and chemistry.
